notes.title: Manifest Destiny is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
 
After two years of development, "Manifest Destiny" is finally officially released today. The game is priced at 4.99 USD with a 10% launch discount.
 
This game tells the common dilemma of creators: struggling between survival and expression under the immense pressure of reality. Along the way, the protagonist will experience various interesting adventures and moral choices, and discuss life and save the world withvarious virtual characters.
 
I hope everyone can find their own fun and meaning in Wan Hu's adventure!

notes.title: 【Patch Notes v1.123】Issue Resolution
notes.content:
Here is the content of this update:

[list]
[*] Fixed the incomplete translation issue of “Pause Menu”.
[*] Fixed the incomplete translation issue of “Branch of fate”.
[*] Fixed the issue where the dialogue for obtaining the "change color" ability was displayed incorrectly.
[*] Fixed the incorrect calculation issue of good and evil values in some stages.
[*] Fixed the incorrect translation of some dialogue.
[/list]

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Dev Live Vol.2 on Feb 9th
notes.content:
Hey everyone, 

I just wanted to give you all a heads-up that the live streaming of the Steam Next Fest developer session for Manifest Destiny is scheduled to take place on February 10th at 15:00 China Standard Time / February 9th at 23:00 Pacific. So make sure to mark your calendars and set reminders, as you won't want to miss out on this Gameplay showcase! We are looking forward to seeing you there!

Manifest Destiny Team
